title: Out-of-town gig in Homer with Willie O'Connell and George McCullough
summary: On off time Harris played with an Italian bandleader in Homer; Willie O'Connell later ran a union office in Biloxi.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I was getting back to the bands. I played with a couple of little small bands, you know what I mean, of course it's not too much but the people say when you make a gig and make a little money or something. Yeah. Yeah. See that was my off time when I wouldn't be doing nothing or traveling like that but I'd take a little job out of town. When I played with an Italian fella in Homer he had a band out there and they sent for me. I went out there, I stayed a couple of weeks out there with him. That's when Alvin Alcorn's brother was playing, the one that died was playing trumpet? George. George McCullough. George McCullough. Yeah. George McCullough, that's Alvin's stepbrother. Yeah I know him. Well we was all together out there with Willie O'Connell. Yeah Willie O'Connell. Yeah and this boy played all that piano, pedal.
We meet him when we go over the lake. On the course we catch up.

Willie O'Connell that was a wonderful guitar player yeah. He was a band-jo player at that time but he was pretty good. He was one of the representatives for our union over there now. He had an office in Biloxi. Yeah he had an office over there. Do they have their own local in Biloxi or is that part of the building?
No that's part of our local.
See he has an office over there. He's running a branch over there. Yeah branch over there.
I didn't know that for sure. That's all.
